milestone: M0 full legacy UI bridge and HTTP/SSE parity inventory

scope.note: The integrator restored the 70 legacy web files byte-for-byte. This artifact inventories them without recopying, rewriting, hiding, disabling or replacing any legacy UI behavior.

authoritative_source.rule: Existing legacy HTML/CSS/JS are authoritative for appearance, features and operations. A safe Electron bridge may change transport, not behavior.

non_claims: This artifact does not claim that the legacy UI already runs in Electron.
This artifact does not claim that any bridge operation or endpoint is implemented in the host/core.
This artifact does not add, remove, hide, disable or simplify any legacy feature.
Counts below are inventory counts, not test results or compatibility proof.
Route precedence and SSE order remain governed by docs/migration/contracts.json; this artifact records UI usage only.

definitions.bridge_site: A distinct legacy code location where the parent document crosses into an iframe window/document, or where an iframe-side runtime publishes a parent-facing contract. Multiple DOM reads inside one helper/function are grouped into one site and all affected source lines are listed.
definitions.host_iframe_site: A parent-side creation or decoration of an iframe element without reaching into its contentWindow/contentDocument.
definitions.bridge_operation: Stable behavior the legacy UI needs across the boundary. It is not a proposed message schema and must not be implemented by guessing.
definitions.http_usage: An observed request issued by legacy UI code plus the response fields the UI actually consumes.
definitions.sse_usage: An observed event type and the legacy UI fields it consumes.
definitions.required_preserved: Needed to keep an existing visible legacy behavior. Cannot be dropped or replaced by a simplified UI.

unresolved: A typed postMessage replacement for direct same-origin DOM access does not exist yet.

The legacy code requires many arbitrary DOM mutations (style, class, element creation, range measurement) that a narrow message API cannot represent without redesigning the UI; the architect must decide the isolation boundary and still preserve behavior.
Figure frames may be cross-origin; legacy code tolerates failure. A safe bridge must preserve this tolerance and not break figures.
No bridge operation is implemented in host/core by this task.
No compatibility test has been run against the restored UI.

transport.json_response: res.json() when possible; non-2xx throws Error(data.error || status) with err.status and err.data
transport.binary_upload: fetch(url, {method:'POST', headers:{X-Slide-Studio-Location, Content-Type: file.type || application/octet-stream}, body:file})
notes: GET requests send X-Slide-Studio-Location but no Content-Type body header.
The location header comes from a meta tag; the location app shell must provide it if required.
EventSource cannot send this header; its location/authentication carrier is not visible in legacy web code and remains unresolved.

operations.request: one of {action:'undo', token} | {action:'rename', deck, name, title?} | {action:'delete', deck}

response_consumed: slides: string[][] (one URL array per rendered page)

operations.request: binary body; Content-Type file.type or application/octet-stream

response_consumed: and round/state fields used for rendering

unresolved: Response shapes listed as fields are only the fields the legacy UI reads; they are not complete server schemas.
Route precedence and exact error semantics remain in docs/migration/contracts.json and must be preserved.
The legacy UI relies on relative URLs and same-origin navigation; an Electron custom protocol or separate asset origin must preserve every URL template above.
Binary uploads and EventSource need a location/session carrier equivalent to X-Slide-Studio-Location; the legacy code does not reveal that design.

transport.instance_count: one EventSource per UI document; home, editor and location shells each open their own document stream
transport.parsing: source.onmessage => JSON.parse(e.data) => dispatch to all onEvent listeners
transport.authentication: No auth/header mechanism visible in legacy web code; unresolved for host integration.

preserved_by_this_task: All 70 packages/web legacy files remain untouched.
Every observed direct iframe bridge site is recorded with source lines and required operation.
Every observed HTTP request issued by legacy home/editor/core-plugin UI is recorded with request and consumed response fields.
Every SSE event type the legacy UI consumes is recorded with consumers and fields.
Legacy static URL templates used by iframes and media are recorded.
not_implemented_by_this_task: No Electron host or core endpoint changes.
No fake endpoints or placeholder UI.
No claim that the restored UI runs, passes tests, or is feature-complete.
integration_requirements: Keep the legacy HTML/CSS/JS visual and behavioral surface intact; do not replace with a minimal UI.
Implement enough bridge capability to preserve arbitrary same-origin DOM operations listed here, or migrate each operation to a typed message contract without dropping behavior.
Preserve iframe URLs, query/hash conventions, injected globals/assets, runtime globals/events and figure animation API.
Preserve all HTTP request/response fields listed here and the route precedence/error contracts in docs/migration/contracts.json.
Preserve SSE framing, event types, consumers and single-stream-per-document behavior.
Provide a location/session carrier for JSON API, binary uploads and EventSource that does not break relative URLs.
open_dependencies: Architect decision: direct same-origin iframe access versus typed postMessage/Electron IPC, including how arbitrary style/DOM/range operations are represented safely.
Host implementation of /api/*, /files/*, /web/* and /api/events with legacy-compatible behavior and error bodies.
Electron custom protocol/origin design that keeps all legacy relative URLs and same-origin iframe assumptions valid.
Location selection and auth/session propagation for fetch, binary upload and EventSource.
PDF/check pipeline integration for pdfMarks, checks overlays, export progress and shot thumbnails.
AI CLI provider integration for login/runtime/chat/handoff contracts.
Test execution against the restored UI and real fixtures; no UI works claim until then.
